moments.title: UK Gears Up for Halloween Weekend
moments.blurb: As Halloween (October 31st) approaches, major UK attractions like Thorpe Park, Alton Towers, and Warwick Castle are hosting their popular spooky events, with many running until November 1st.

angles.name: Spooky Thrills
angles.copy: Who's heading for Fright Nights or Scarefest this week? Halloween is almost here, and the UK's theme parks are pulling out all the stops! 👻🎢

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: From Brick or Treat at LEGOLAND to haunted castles, there's still time to get your little monsters their Halloween fix before November hits! 🎃

moments.title: Storm Boelo Brings Disruption Across UK
moments.blurb: Storm Boelo is causing widespread disruption across Wales, Northern England, and parts of Scotland today, with flood warnings, road closures, and train cancellations due to heavy rain and high winds.

angles.name: Wales Impact
angles.copy: Stay safe out there! Storm Boelo is battering Wales with high winds and flooding, causing road closures and train cancellations across the region. Check your travel before you go.

angles.name: UK Weather Warning
angles.copy: Another one! Storm Boelo is bringing heavy rain and powerful gusts across the UK today, with amber wind warnings in place for parts of Scotland and Northern England.
